# Keyboard

The same table the app binds and the `?` sheet renders, so a key that
works is a key listed here and the reverse.

## Everywhere

| Key               | Does                        |
| ----------------- | --------------------------- |
| <kbd>J</kbd>      | shortcut.nextPage           |
| <kbd>K</kbd>      | shortcut.previousPage       |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | shortcut.closeForm          |
| <kbd>?</kbd>      | shortcut.toggleShortcutHelp |
